claim_text: eNK -> dNK (menstrual cycle to pregnancy transition)

audit.primary_source_citation: Feyaerts D, Benner M, Comitini G, Shadmanfar W, van der Heijden OWH, Joosten I, van der Molen RG. "NK cell receptor profiling of endometrial and decidual NK cells reveals pregnancy-induced adaptations." Front Immunol. 2024;15:1353556. doi:10.3389/fimmu.2024.1353556. PMID 38571943 / PMC10987737. [Selected as primary because it is the only located primary paper whose stated aim is to test the eNK->dNK precursor proposition head-on in humans; full text and methods read and archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/S3_PMC10987737.txt and /home/user/aaa/refs/S3_PMC10987737_METHODS_verbatim.txt. Co-canonical human source Strunz B et al., Sci Immunol 2021;6(56):eabb7800, PMID 33617461, doi:10.1126/sciimmunol.abb7800 — closed access, methods NOT read (see fulltext_unavailable_reason). Supporting readable primaries: Whettlock EM et al., Front Immunol 2022;13:880438, PMID 35784314 / PMC9245422; Sojka DK et al., J Immunol 2018;201:2551-6, PMID 30275046 / PMC6552671 (mouse).]
audit.fulltext_unavailable_reason: Feyaerts 2024 (designated primary) was obtained in full, including verbatim Materials and Methods. The co-canonical source the claim also rests on — Strunz et al. Sci Immunol 2021, eabb7800 — could NOT be read: Unpaywall reports oa_status "closed", is_oa false, has_repository_copy false, oa_locations []; the Europe PMC core record lists exactly one fullTextUrl with availability "Subscription required" and lit.py returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY; WebFetch of https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciimmunol.abb7800 returns HTTP 403; searches of KI/Cambridge repositories returned no deposited manuscript. I therefore did NOT paraphrase its abstract as methods. The only method-level facts I could verify for Strunz 2021 come from the authors' own deposited analysis repository (github.com/darogan/KI_Strunz_Bjorkstrom, ArrayExpress E-MTAB-8709): 12 BULK RNA-seq libraries from 4 uterine donors, sorted into CD39-KIR-, CD39-KIR+, CD39+KIR+ uNK (4 libraries each); the deposited pipeline is FastQC/STAR/featureCounts/DESeq2 with NO pseudotime, RNA-velocity or scRNA-seq step. So the "continuous differentiation pathway" in its title is an ordering of static sorted subsets by marker acquisition, not a tracked transition.
audit.species: Human (primary source and entire human evidence base). The only lineage-grade experiments bearing on the claim are in mouse (C57BL/6 Ncr1-iCre x Rosa-mT/mG parabionts, Sojka 2018; Rosa26-RFP x Tbx21-Cre fate map, Mohamed 2026 PMID 41782473).
audit.what_was_measured: In humans, in an unpaired cross-sectional design, surface NK-receptor repertoire (KIR2DL1/S1, KIR2DL2/L3/S2, KIR2DS1, KIR3DL1/S1, LILRB1, NKG2A, NKG2C, NKG2D, NKp30, NKp46, CD244) was measured by 10-colour flow cytometry on CD3-CD56+ cells, and 64 receptor co-expression subpopulations enumerated, in two separate donor groups: (a) endometrial NK cells recovered from MENSTRUAL BLOOD collected within the first 36 h of menstruation (n=26 healthy non-pregnant women; RosetteSep granulocyte depletion + Ficoll), used as a proxy for endometrium; and (b) decidual NK cells released from first-trimester decidual tissue at 6-15 weeks of elective termination (n=14 different women; Accutase/gentleMACS digestion + discontinuous Percoll). Group frequencies were compared. No woman contributed both an endometrial and a decidual sample; no cell, clone or donor was observed at more than one reproductive stage; no label, barcode, chimerism marker or proliferation readout was used. Supporting cross-sectional work is the same design: Whettlock 2022 measured uNK1/2/3 frequency, KIR2D/LILRB1/CD94 expression and PMA-ionomycin-induced CD107a/TNF/IFN-gamma/IL-8/GM-CSF at 7 reproductive stages in 29 endometrial Pipelle biopsies (8 menstrual, 7 proliferative, 10 secretory, 4 postpartum) plus 10 first-trimester and 16 term decidual samples, each stage from different women, integrated with four published scRNA-seq datasets (proliferative n=3, secretory n=3, first trimester n=5, second trimester n=1, third trimester n=3 donors).
audit.n: Primary (Feyaerts 2024): 26 menstrual-blood/endometrium donors + 14 first-trimester decidua donors = 40 total, 0 paired. Supporting (Whettlock 2022): 29 endometrial biopsies + 10 first-trimester + 16 term decidua + 18 labour samples, 0 paired across the non-pregnant/pregnant boundary; its scRNA-seq arm pooled 15 donors across 5 stages. Strunz 2021 bulk RNA-seq arm: 4 donors, 12 libraries (from deposited data only). Mouse lineage work (Sojka 2018): 6 decidualized horns from 2 independent parabiosis experiments (n=6 parabiotic pairs), plus gd6.5 n=4 and gd11.5 n=8, deciduoma n=10.
audit.n_unit: women (independent donors); 0 endometrium-decidua pairs from the same individual anywhere in the located human literature. Mouse figures are parabiotic pairs / animals. NOT cells.
audit.controls: Primary (Feyaerts 2024) controls are thin and the authors say so: NO paired within-woman control ("we had no access to paired samples, i.e. endometrial and decidual NK cells from the same individual"); NO peripheral-blood comparator reported in Materials and methods; NO KIR genotyping for the decidua donors ("we lack KIR genotyping results for the donors of the abortion material, preventing us from making adjustments"); NO age/parity/gravidity data for decidua donors (anonymous donation); menstrual blood used as an endometrium proxy that the authors concede has never been validated head-to-head against biopsy in the same individual; enzymatic-digestion epitope loss addressed only by citing prior work, not by an experiment in this paper. Note the two arms use DIFFERENT tissue sources and DIFFERENT isolation chemistries (RosetteSep/Ficoll on menstrual blood vs Accutase/gentleMACS/Percoll on decidua), which is uncontrolled. The one genuinely useful negative control in the corpus is in Whettlock 2022, which took matched peripheral venous blood from every donor and found pNK frequency and KIR/LILRB1/CD94 expression unchanged across all 7 stages — this makes a purely systemic/technical explanation for the uterine changes less likely, but says nothing about whether the uterine cells are the same cells.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/EXPANSION OF A PRE-EXISTING SUBSET, plus local proliferation — and it is not a hypothetical. All three uNK subsets (uNK1/uNK2/uNK3) are already present in non-pregnant endometrium at menstrual, proliferative and secretory phase (Whettlock 2022), so every reported "pregnancy-induced adaptation" is fully explained by differential expansion/attrition of pre-existing states under progesterone and IL-15 with no cell changing identity: the frequency of a state can rise without any cell converting into it. The mouse experiment that can actually distinguish these — Sojka 2018, Ncr1-iCre x Rosa-mT/mG reporter mice in parabiosis with experimentally induced deciduomata — comes down on the expansion side: "the accumulated uNK cells were proliferating trNK cells; migrating NK cells made no contribution." The 2026 mouse Tbx21-Cre fate map likewise concludes "subset redistribution", explicitly "rather than undergoing lineage diversion." Two further alternatives are live: (i) REPLACEMENT FROM CIRCULATION — Vacca 2011 (PMID 21248224) shows CD34+ precursors resident in decidua differentiate into NK cells on stromal contact, i.e. de novo local generation from precursors rather than from eNK, and Carlino 2008 (PMID 18187664) shows chemokine-driven recruitment of circulating NK through decidual tissue; (ii) TECHNICAL ARTEFACT — the primary study's "endometrial" cells are menstrual-blood-derived and its "decidual" cells are enzymatically digested tissue, so the KIR-down/NCR-up difference could be a sampling and digestion-epitope artefact. Nothing in the human record discriminates conversion from any of these, because no human cell has ever been followed across the boundary.
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, and it is human and direct. Strunz B, Ivarsson MA, ... Björkström NK. "Reconstitution of the uterine immune milieu after uterus or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation." Sci Transl Med 2026;18(840):eadp2583, PMID 41811987 (abstract-only; closed access, methods not read — flagged as such): using SNP- and HLA-disparity-based single-cell assignment of donor vs recipient origin by scRNA-seq and high-parameter flow cytometry in women after uterus transplantation or HSCT, "Recipient-derived immune cells replaced donor immune cells after uterus transplant, whereas HSCT resulted in near-complete donor-derived immune reconstitution, including formation of tissue-resident lymphocytes," and in one patient male-origin cells reconstituted the endometrium. That is direct human chimerism evidence that the endometrial uNK compartment is continuously refilled from circulating precursors — i.e. the endometrial NK pool present in one cycle need not be the pool present in the next, let alone the dNK pool of a later pregnancy. The same group's 2021 abstract concedes the point ("the uNK cell niche could be replenished from circulation"). Second counter-line: Feyaerts D et al. 2019, Cell Mol Immunol 16:410-1, PMID 30635647 / PMC6462002 (10 nulligravidae vs 25 multigravidae, CMV-stratified) shows the "pregnancy-trained" NKG2C+LILRB1+ endometrial NK signature that Gamliel 2018 (PMID 29768178) used to argue eNK are dNK precursors is partly CMV-driven — "the increase of pregnancy-induced LILRB1 expression on NKG2C+ eNK cells only occurs in CMVpos and not in CMVneg women" — i.e. a confounder, not a pregnancy-lineage relationship. Third: Huhn 2020 (PMID 31959757), 41-marker CyTOF on 28 first-trimester decidua donors, "did not identify a cluster directly corresponding to 'pregnancy trained dNK cells' (PTdNK)." Note also that Gamliel 2018 itself only claims "The precursors of PTdNKs SEEM TO BE found in the endometrium." I searched specifically for a human study sampling endometrium and decidua from the same woman and found none; Feyaerts 2024 states such pairing "poses inconceivable logistic and ethical barriers."
audit.downstream_dependency: (1) CLINICAL PRE-CONCEPTION uNK TESTING. Non-pregnant endometrial biopsy CD56+ uNK density/percentage is offered commercially and in RM/RIF clinics to triage women to prednisolone, intralipid or IVIG. The entire diagnostic logic requires that the eNK measured in a luteal-phase biopsy are the cells that will constitute the dNK compartment of a future pregnancy — i.e. it is exactly claim S3. See the systematic review/meta-analysis of this literature, "Number and function of uterine natural killer cells in recurrent miscarriage and implantation failure" (PMID 35265977 / PMC9247428). If the compartment is instead refilled from circulation between the biopsy and the pregnancy (Strunz 2026 STM), the biopsy is not measuring the cells it is claimed to predict. (2) THE CROSS-STAGE uNK1/2/3 ATLAS. Whettlock 2022 applies the dNK1/dNK2/dNK3 labels — defined by Vento-Tormo et al. in first-trimester DECIDUA — to non-pregnant endometrial cells and then reports that "uNK1 and uNK2 peak in the first trimester" and that "uNK subsets upregulate KIR and LILRB1 during transition from non-pregnant endometrium to first-trimester decidua." Both are statements about one population changing over time and are only interpretable if S3 holds; otherwise they are statements about the relative abundance of unrelated populations in unrelated women. (3) THE PTdNK / TRAINED-MEMORY MODEL. Gamliel 2018 Immunity's proposal that pregnancy training persists in the endometrium between pregnancies and improves placentation in subsequent pregnancies (and the derived "learning from experience" framework, PMID 30802436) rests entirely on eNK->dNK continuity across the cycle-to-pregnancy boundary.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: The initial call INFERENCE is confirmed, not overturned — but it is too generous in two ways that the row should record. (a) It should be tightened to INF_MARKER specifically. There is no human observation of persistence or conversion at all: the primary source is an unpaired between-groups flow-cytometry comparison of 26 menstrual-blood donors against 14 decidua donors, and the authors state that paired sampling "poses inconceivable logistic and ethical barriers." Every supporting human study has the same architecture. There is no pseudotime/velocity claim to demote here, but the word "differentiation pathway" in the Strunz 2021 title denotes ordering of statically sorted CD39/KIR subsets, which is INF_MARKER dressed as INF_TRAJECTORY. (b) More importantly, INFERENCE reads as "unproven but unopposed", and that is wrong: the claim is actively opposed. The only parabiosis experiment in the field (Sojka 2018, mouse) attributes uNK accumulation at decidualization to local proliferation of a pre-existing tissue-resident pool with zero contribution from migrating NK; the 2026 mouse T-bet fate map calls the gestational change "subset redistribution ... rather than undergoing lineage diversion"; and human transplantation chimerism (Strunz 2026 STM) shows the endometrial immune compartment being replaced from circulation after uterus transplant and reconstituted donor-wide after HSCT. Each of these is compatible with dNK arising by selection/expansion or fresh recruitment rather than by eNK converting. The claim as worded ("eNK -> dNK") should be recorded as an untested precursor hypothesis that the field itself hedges (Feyaerts 2024: "It is hypothesized that NK cells in the endometrium are precursors for decidual NK cells"; Gamliel 2018: precursors "seem to be found in the endometrium"), not as an established transition. Distinct from S2: this row is only about the temporal non-pregnant->pregnant boundary, and that specific boundary has never been crossed by any labelled cell in any species.
audit.methods_quote: Feyaerts 2024, Materials and methods, Tissue sampling (verbatim, archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/S3_PMC10987737_METHODS_verbatim.txt): "Menstrual blood was collected from 26 healthy women during the first 36 hours of menstruation, as described earlier (4, 23). Decidual tissue from 14 women undergoing elective termination of normal pregnancy between 6 and 15 weeks of gestation was collected at the Mildred Clinic Arnhem (Arnhem, the Netherlands). Tissues from elective terminations were donated anonymously. As such, demographics information such as age and parity/gravidity is not available for these samples." // Discussion, limitations (verbatim): "Firstly, we had no access to paired samples, i.e. endometrial and decidual NK cells from the same individual. Paired samples would shed light onto the specific changes NK cells undergo in a single individual. However, this poses inconceivable logistic and ethical barriers." // Discussion, framing the claim as untested (verbatim): "It is hypothesized that NK cells in non-pregnant endometrium are precursors of decidual NK cells present during pregnancy." // Sojka 2018 abstract (verbatim, PMID 30275046): "In parabiosis studies using experimentally induced deciduomata, the accumulated uNK cells were proliferating trNK cells; migrating NK cells made no contribution."
audit.notes: SOURCE-LOCATION RESULTS, including negatives, per G3. (i) SEARCHED AND COULD NOT FIND: any human study sampling endometrium and decidua from the SAME individual (search: "paired longitudinal same woman endometrial biopsy prior to pregnancy and decidua uterine NK cells lineage" — returned only conference-abstract noise); any human lineage-tracing, barcoding, TCR/KIR-clonotype tracking, deuterium/BrdU labelling or in-vivo persistence assay spanning the cycle-to-pregnancy boundary. (ii) SEARCHED AND FOUND BUT UNREADABLE: Strunz 2021 Sci Immunol (paywalled, verified closed via Unpaywall API and Europe PMC core record; science.org 403). Strunz 2026 Sci Transl Med PMID 41811987 is also abstract-only in this environment; its counter-evidence value above is taken from the abstract and is labelled as such rather than presented as read methods. (iii) HINT VERIFICATION: the hint's framing that "in humans the two timepoints are almost never obtainable from the same individual" is confirmed and is stated in the primary source's own words — it is not merely a practical limitation, it is the reason the entire human evidence base is INF_MARKER. (iv) A material and under-reported design fact: the primary study's "endometrial NK" are MENSTRUAL-BLOOD-derived, not biopsy-derived, and the authors concede that a biopsy-vs-menstrual-blood comparison "preferably in the same individual, is still needed." adv.challenge_reason: TWO SEPARATE VERDICTS. (a) ON THE PAPER THE AUDITOR CHOSE: UPHELD. I re-ran `lit.py methods 38571943 --tag S3ADV` myself (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/S3ADV_PMC10987737.txt) and read the verbatim Materials and methods. The auditor's account is accurate and honest: 10-colour flow cytometry of 17 NKRs on CD3-CD56+ cells from 26 menstrual-blood donors vs 14 elective-termination decidua donors, compared between groups by Mann-Whitney, 0 paired. No OBS_* class was wrongly credited, no pseudotime was smuggled in as observation, no fate-map was missed inside that paper. For Feyaerts 2024 alone, INF_MARKER is correct. (b) ON THE ROW: UPGRADE, because A.1 was answered wrongly and the strongest class follows the source. The auditor wrote that Feyaerts 2024 "is the only located primary paper whose stated aim is to test the eNK->dNK precursor proposition head-on in humans." That is false, and Feyaerts' own Results give it away: "NK cells in the non-pregnant endometrium have been implied to be precursors of decidual NK cells (17, 18)." The originating primary source is Manaster I, Mizrahi S, Goldman-Wohl D, ... Yagel S, Mandelboim O. "Endometrial NK cells are special immature cells that await pregnancy." J Immunol 2008;181(3):1869-76, PMID 18641324, doi 10.4049/jimmunol.181.3.1869 — the paper that created the claim and the only one in the corpus containing an actual conversion experiment (eNK + IL-15 in culture -> acquisition of dNK-like phenotype AND function). Its MeSH indexing, which is methods-derived rather than abstract-derived, confirms the design class: "Cells, Cultured", "Interleukin-15/pharmacology", "Cell Differentiation/immunology", "Up-Regulation/drug effects", "Chlorocebus aethiops". So INF_INVITRO is present and, on the class ordering given (OBS_DIRECT/OBS_TRANSFER/OBS_GENETIC/INF_INVITRO/INF_MARKER/INF_TRAJECTORY/INF_KINETIC), it outranks INF_MARKER. The auditor already listed INF_INVITRO in evidence_types_all but never attributed it to any paper and never let it set the strongest class — internally incoherent. Revised evidence_types_all: INF_INVITRO, INF_MARKER, INF_TRAJECTORY. G1 CAVEAT, stated rather than papered over: I could NOT read Manaster's Methods. Unpaywall reports is_oa true / oa_status BRONZE with best_oa_location = the publisher PDF, but journals.aai.org/jimmunol/article-pdf/181/3/1869/1257098/zim01508001869.pdf returns HTTP 200 with a 1,519-byte JavaScript bot-challenge page, not a PDF; www.jimmunol.org/content/181/3/1869.full returns HTTP 403; journals.aai.org article pages 301-redirect to the academic.oup.com/jimmunol journal root rather than the article; has_repository_copy=false; the Wayback availability API returned HTTP 429. The INF_INVITRO assignment is therefore PROVISIONAL, from MeSH indexing, not from read methods — SEARCHED AND FOUND BUT METHODS UNREADABLE, not NOT_SEARCHED. CRITICAL RIDER (G7 runs the other way here): this UPGRADE is a taxonomy correction and makes the claim LESS credible, not more. The in vitro conversion is NON-DISCRIMINATING between S3 and its main rival, because the same milieu converts peripheral blood NK equally well — Keskin 2007 PNAS PMID 17360654 / PMC1805591, "TGFbeta promotes conversion of CD16+ peripheral blood NK cells into CD16- NK cells with similarities to decidual NK cells", a point Feyaerts 2024's own Discussion repeats verbatim: "culturing of peripheral NK cells with TGFbeta1 or conditioned medium derived from decidual stromal cells resulted in accumulation of NK cells with a decidual NK cell phenotype, i.e. increased CD56 intensity, loss of CD16, and increased frequency of KIR+ NK cells." If pNK do it too, the assay shows only that the decidual milieu imposes a dNK phenotype on whatever NK cell is in it — a phenotype-CONVERGENCE result, which is an argument against inferring ancestry from phenotype, not for it. NO OBS_* UPGRADE IS WARRANTED, and I checked the one candidate that could have carried OBS_GENETIC. I read the methods of the auditor's Mohamed 2026 T-bet fate map (PMID 41782473 / PMC12961421, archived S3_PMC12961421.txt): Rosa26-tdTomato x Tbx21-Cre is a CONSTITUTIVE, non-inducible fate map, virgin and GD6-18 animals are separate cross-sectional groups ("Virgin mice and the mice at various specified GD ... were sacrificed"), and splenic cNK are also labelled ("maternal spleen Lin-CD45+ cells showed very high RFP proportion"). An RFP+ cell in GD8 decidua therefore cannot be distinguished from a blood-derived arrival, so the fate map does not test S3 and confers no OBS_GENETIC. Its transcriptomic arm is n=1 sample per timepoint (2 virgin, 2 GD6 mice). Note also a live G1 specimen inside that paper: its abstract says RFP+ cells "altered their lineage identity towards ILC2 or ILC3 fate" while its own Results/Discussion say "we show no evidence of ILC1-ILC2 transition, as GATA3 was not detected" and "T-bet downregulation in dNK cells was not accompanied by trans-differentiation toward alternative ILC lineages as neither RORgt nor GATA3 was induced in RFP+ cells."
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: INF_INVITRO (provisional; from Manaster 2008 PMID 18641324, the originating primary source, whose IL-15 conversion culture is confirmed by MeSH methods-indexing but whose Methods text is unreadable in this environment — see challenge_reason). Full set present: INF_INVITRO, INF_MARKER, INF_TRAJECTORY. The auditor's INF_MARKER is correct for their chosen paper (Feyaerts 2024) but wrong for the claim's evidence base. Upgrade in class label only; the claim is LESS supported after this audit, not more, because the in vitro conversion is non-discriminating (peripheral NK convert identically, Keskin 2007 PMID 17360654).
adv.new_counter_evidence:
THE AUDITOR ASSERTED A CONSENSUS THAT DOES NOT EXIST. They wrote "The only parabiosis experiment in the field (Sojka 2018, mouse)... comes down on the expansion side." Four located papers falsify both the "only" and the "consensus", and three were missed entirely.

(1) MISSED — Chantakru S, Miller C, Roach LE, Kuziel WA, Maeda N, Wang WC, Evans SS, Croy BA. "Contributions from self-renewal and trafficking to the uterine NK cell population of early pregnancy." J Immunol 2002;168(1):22-8, PMID 11751942. Methods ABSTRACT_ONLY in this environment (no PMC, archived /home/user/aaa/refs/S3ADV_11751942.txt), flagged as such; MeSH confirms design class: Adoptive Transfer, Bone Marrow Transplantation, Uterus/transplantation, Mice SCID, Mice Knockout, Rag2/Il2rg. Orthotopic UTERINE GRAFTS from NK-competent mice into NK/uNK-deficient vs wild-type recipients, plus thymus/BM/LN/spleen grafts from virgin or pregnant donors into mated NK-deficient recipients. Verbatim: "Only in wild-type recipients did decidualized grafts contain uNK cells, indicating that pre-uNK cells do not self-renew in uterus" and "These data support a model that attributes the dramatic increases in human and murine uNK cells during decidualization to precursor cell recruitment." This is an OBS_TRANSFER-class experiment on exactly the boundary S3 asserts, and its conclusion is the direct opposite of Sojka 2018.

(2) MISSED, AND IT COMES FROM THE AUDITOR'S OWN HEADLINE LAB — Tatematsu BK, Sojka DK. "Tissue-resident natural killer cells derived from conventional natural killer cells are regulated by progesterone in the uterus." Mucosal Immunol 2025;18(2):390-401, PMID 39708955, doi 10.1016/j.mucimm.2024.12.009. Methods ABSTRACT_ONLY (Elsevier, no PMC; archived S3ADV_39708955.txt), flagged; MeSH: Parabiosis, Ovariectomy, Progesterone/pharmacology, Medroxyprogesterone Acetate/pharmacology, Receptors Progesterone/antagonists & inhibitors, Cell Differentiation. Parabiosis + intravascular fluorescent antibody labelling + ovariectomy + hormone add-back + PR antagonist. Verbatim: "mice OVX at three weeks of age and analyzed as adults lacked uterine trNK cells unless progesterone was administered. Our parabiosis studies confirmed that the progesterone-responsive trNK cells are derived from peripheral cNK cells." This is doubly fatal to S3: the uterine resident NK pool is DERIVED FROM CIRCULATING cNK by parabiosis-grade evidence, and it is emptied and refilled under the control of PROGESTERONE — the very hormone driving the secretory-to-decidual transition S3 spans. The endometrial NK pool is therefore not a standing reservoir waiting for pregnancy; it is a hormonally gated, continuously replenished compartment. Same lab as the auditor's Sojka 2018, seven years later, largely retracting the framing the auditor built the row on.

(3) MISSED — Chiossone L, Vacca P, Orecchia P, Croxatto D, Damonte P, Astigiano S, Barbieri O, Bottino C, Moretta L, Mingari MC. "In vivo generation of decidual natural killer cells from resident hematopoietic progenitors." Haematologica 2014;99(3):448-57, PMID 24179150, PMC3943307 (lit.py returns ABSTRACT_ONLY for the body; flagged). Adoptive transfer of EGFP+ mature NK cells versus EGFP+ precursors into pregnant mice. Verbatim: "mature natural killer cells did not migrate into decidua and uterus, while precursors were recruited in these organs and differentiated towards natural killer cells." This is the in vivo OBS_TRANSFER version of the auditor's in vitro Vacca 2011 point, and it specifically EXCLUDES mature NK cells — which is what eNK are — as the source of dNK.

(4) MISSED — the "two independent origins" alternative that A.4 names is not hypothetical, it is experimentally established IN THIS TISSUE: Sojka DK, Plougastel-Douglas B, Yang L, Pak-Wittel MA, Artyomov MN, Ivanova Y, Zhong C, Chase JM, Rothman PB, Yu J, Riley JK, Zhu J, Tian Z, Yokoyama WM. "Tissue-resident natural killer (NK) cells are cell lineages distinct from thymic and conventional splenic NK cells." eLife 2014;3:e01659, PMID 24714492, PMC3975579 — FULL TEXT READ AND ARCHIVED (/home/user/aaa/refs/S3ADV_PMC3975579.txt). Parabiosis plus Foxn1-/-, Nfil3-/- and Tbx21-/- mice. Verbatim: "the uterus and skin contain both trNK (CD49a+ DX5-) and circulating cNK (CD49a- DX5+) cNK cells"; "the uterine trNK cells were still present in Tbet-deficient mice, strongly suggesting that uterine trNK cells represent yet another NK cell lineage"; "there are at least four distinct lineages of NK cells: cNK, thymic, liver (and skin) trNK, and uterine trNK cells." Consequence for S3 that the auditor never drew: "eNK" and "dNK" are each MIXTURES of at least two independent NK lineages, so every between-group frequency shift Feyaerts 2024 reports — KIR down, NCR up — is fully explained by a change in the trNK:cNK mixing ratio with not one cell converting into anything. This is a cleaner statement of the canonical alternative than "selection/expansion", because it needs no differential survival either: only a change in the proportions of two populations that were never related.

NET: the mouse literature is openly contradictory — Chantakru 2002 (recruitment; residents do not self-renew) vs Chiossone 2014 (precursor recruitment, mature NK excluded) vs Sojka 2018 (local proliferation, no migration) vs Tatematsu 2025 (cNK-derived, progesterone-gated). The auditor's counter_evidence verdict FOUND survives, but the reasons given were weaker and partly wrong, and their strongest single citation (Sojka 2018) is contradicted by the same lab's 2025 parabiosis and by the 2002 uterine-graft experiment. I confirm the auditor's honest negatives: Strunz 2021 (10.1126/sciimmunol.abb7800) independently re-verified via Unpaywall as is_oa false / oa_status closed / has_repository_copy false / 0 oa_locations; Gamliel 2018 (PMID 29768178) is ABSTRACT_ONLY here and does hedge ("The precursors of PTdNKs seem to be found in the endometrium"); Whettlock 2022's uNK1/2/3-already-present-in-endometrium claim verified verbatim in the archived text ("three subpopulations of uNK, uNK1, uNK2, and uNK3, are present in first-trimester decidua and non-pregnant endometrium").

NOT_SEARCHED: non-human-primate (macaque/baboon) endometrium-to-decidua work; institutional/interlibrary retrieval of Manaster 2008 or Strunz 2021 beyond the routes listed above.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The structural questions S3 borrows are (i) recruitment versus residency and (ii) whether marker-ordered cross-sectional snapshots license an ancestry claim. All three home fields have solved these with methods the uterine NK field has never applied to this boundary, and every one of them cuts against S3.

MYELOID — THE DECISIVE RESULT, AND IT KILLS THE INFERENCE OUTRIGHT. van de Laar L et al., "Yolk sac macrophages, fetal liver, and adult monocytes can colonize an empty niche and develop into functional tissue-resident macrophages", Immunity 2016;44(4):755-68, PMID 26992565: three ontogenetically unrelated precursor populations transferred into an empty alveolar niche each become phenotypically and functionally indistinguishable resident macrophages. Lavin Y et al., "Tissue-resident macrophage enhancer landscapes are shaped by the local microenvironment", Cell 2014;159(6):1312-26, PMID 25480296: the resident phenotype is written by the niche onto whatever cell occupies it, and transferred macrophages reprogram their enhancers to the host tissue. Also Machiels/organ-specific refilling dynamics, PMID 30540942. General principle: in a tissue niche, phenotype is determined by the niche, not by ancestry. S3 is an inference from phenotypic resemblance between a uterine population at time 1 and a uterine population at time 2 in DIFFERENT WOMEN. The myeloid field established that such resemblance is exactly what you get when unrelated cells occupy the same niche. This is not a caveat on S3's evidence; it is a demonstration that S3's evidence type cannot in principle discriminate the claim from its alternative.

TRM / HUMAN TRANSPLANT CHIMERISM — THE FIELD'S ACTUAL STANDARD, AND IT SHOWS CONVERGENCE IN HUMANS. Snyder ME et al., "Generation and persistence of human tissue-resident memory T cells in lung transplantation", Sci Immunol 2019;4(33):eaav5581, PMID 30850393, PMC6435356 — methods read via lit.py: longitudinal airway sampling from HLA-disparate lung transplant recipients with donor and recipient cells tracked by HLA disparity. Verbatim: "Donor T cells persist specifically in the lungs (and not blood) of transplant recipients and express high levels of TRM signature markers including CD69, CD103, and CD49a, whereas lung-infiltrating recipient T cells gradually acquire TRM phenotypes over months in vivo", "suggesting de novo TRM generation." Bearing on S3: newly recruited blood-derived cells acquire the full tissue-residency marker signature (CD69, CD103, CD49a — the identical markers used to call a uterine cell "uNK") within months, in humans, in vivo. So a CD49a+CD69+ cell in first-trimester decidua is not evidence of descent from a CD49a+CD69+ cell in non-pregnant endometrium. This is the same HLA/SNP-disparity chimerism methodology as the auditor's Strunz 2026 STM, and it shows the inference S3 makes has been directly tested and invalidated in the one lineage where the experiment is routine. Mouse counterpart: Steinert EM et al., Cell 2015;161(4):737-49, PMID 25957682 — establishes that a residency claim requires intravascular labelling to exclude vascular contamination plus parabiosis to show non-equilibration. Neither has ever been performed for human eNK or dNK; Tatematsu 2025 (PMID 39708955) applies exactly this standard to the mouse uterus and finds the trNK are cNK-derived.

ILC — RESIDENCY IS CONDITIONAL, AND PERTURBATION OPENS THE NICHE. Gasteiger G, Fan X, Dikiy S, Lee SY, Rudensky AY, "Tissue residency of innate lymphoid cells in lymphoid and nonlymphoid organs", Science 2015;350(6263):981-5, PMID 26472762, PMC4720139: ILCs are tissue-resident and locally self-renewing at steady state, "However, at later time points after infection, cells from hematogenous sources helped to partially replenish the pool of resident ILCs." The field that established ILC residency also established that residency does not survive a large perturbation. Pregnancy is the largest physiological perturbation the uterine niche undergoes, and Tatematsu 2025 shows the uterine ILC/NK niche is additionally under direct progesterone control. So the ILC field's own finding predicts hematogenous replenishment across precisely the boundary S3 assumes is closed.

T CELL SUBSET-DIFFERENTIATION ORDERING — THE METHOD ITSELF IS FALSIFIED. Buchholz VR et al., "Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity", Science 2013;340(6132):630-5, PMID 23493420: single-cell fate mapping shows one naive precursor gives heterogeneous progeny, so a population-level ordering of subsets by marker acquisition systematically misassigns precursor-product relationships. This is the general refutation of the "sort the subsets, order them by marker acquisition, call it a differentiation pathway" method — which is exactly what Strunz 2021's title phrase "continuous human uterine NK cell differentiation" denotes (12 bulk RNA-seq libraries from 4 donors sorted into CD39-KIR-, CD39-KIR+, CD39+KIR+ per the auditor's own repository check) and what Whettlock 2022's uNK1/2/3 cross-stage ordering does.

EXHAUSTION — searched for completeness though S3 does not invoke it: Blank CU et al., "Defining 'T cell exhaustion'", Nat Rev Immunol 2019;19(11):665-74, PMID 31570879 — the CD8 field's consensus that the label requires defined criteria (chronic antigen exposure, hierarchical inhibitory-receptor co-expression, a distinct epigenetic state) and must not be exported to other lineages on marker resemblance alone. Same structural lesson as above, not load-bearing for this claim.

BOTTOM LINE FOR S3: every field that owns this mechanism converged on the same rule — you establish "A becomes B" in a tissue by chimerism (parabiosis in mouse, transplant/HSCT SNP or HLA disparity in human), never by comparing marker profiles of two populations sampled at two times. Applied to S3 that rule returns nothing supporting and four experiments opposing.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
HIGH is correct and I verified the auditor's strongest named dependency rather than accepting it. CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 1 — CLINICAL PRE-CONCEPTION uNK TESTING. Verified: PMID 35265977, Hum Reprod Update 2022;28(4):548, "Number and function of uterine natural killer cells in recurrent miscarriage and implantation failure: a systematic review and meta-analysis." Luteal-phase endometrial biopsy CD56+ uNK density is sold commercially and used in recurrent-miscarriage / recurrent-implantation-failure clinics to triage women to prednisolone, intralipid or IVIG. The diagnostic syllogism has no step other than S3: it requires that the eNK counted in a non-pregnant biopsy are the cells that will constitute the dNK compartment of a later pregnancy. If they are not, the test measures a population that no longer exists by the time the outcome it predicts occurs. Real patients receive real immunosuppression on this inference.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 2 — WHICH I ADD, AND WHICH HARDENS THE AUDITOR'S CONDITIONAL INTO A MECHANISM. The auditor wrote the failure mode as a hypothetical ("If the compartment is instead refilled from circulation between the biopsy and the pregnancy (Strunz 2026 STM), the biopsy is not measuring the cells it is claimed to predict"), resting it on an abstract-only 2026 paper. Tatematsu BK & Sojka DK, Mucosal Immunol 2025;18(2):390-401, PMID 39708955 supplies the mechanism experimentally: uterine trNK are derived from peripheral cNK by parabiosis, and ovariectomised mice LACK uterine trNK unless progesterone is administered, with MPA-induced expansion abolished by a progesterone-receptor antagonist. Progesterone is the hormone that defines the luteal phase in which the diagnostic biopsy is taken and that rises through early pregnancy. So the biopsy-to-conception interval is precisely the interval over which the compartment is hormonally turned over and re-derived from blood. That converts "the biopsy may not be measuring the right cells" from a caveat into a positively demonstrated turnover mechanism in the model organism.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 3 — the auditor's cross-stage atlas dependency is real and I verified its wording: Whettlock 2022 (PMID 35784314 / PMC9245422) applies dNK1/dNK2/dNK3 labels defined in first-trimester decidua to non-pregnant endometrium and reports "an increase in the frequency of uNK1 when transitioning from the secretory phase to first-trimester pregnancy" — a sentence about one population changing over time, built from different women at each stage, interpretable only if S3 holds. I note that the auditor's third dependency (Gamliel 2018 PTdNK / trained-memory) is weaker than they implied, because Gamliel itself only claims the precursors "seem to be found in the endometrium" and Huhn 2020 (PMID 31959757) failed to recover the PTdNK cluster by 41-marker CyTOF — a dependency resting on a hedge that has already failed one replication is a weak load-bearing argument, and the row should lean on dependencies 1 and 2 instead. Load-bearing remains HIGH on the strength of the clinical dependency alone.
adv.better_primary_source:
YES — the auditor answered A.1 wrongly. ORIGINAL PRIMARY SOURCE: Manaster I, Mizrahi S, Goldman-Wohl D, Sela HY, Stern-Ginossar N, Lankry D, Gruda R, Hurwitz A, Bdolah Y, Haimov-Kochman R, Yagel S, Mandelboim O. "Endometrial NK cells are special immature cells that await pregnancy." J Immunol 2008;181(3):1869-76. PMID 18641324. doi:10.4049/jimmunol.181.3.1869. This is the paper that created the eNK->dNK precursor proposition, it is the source Feyaerts 2024 cites for it ("NK cells in the non-pregnant endometrium have been implied to be precursors of decidual NK cells (17, 18)"), and it is the only paper in the corpus containing an actual conversion experiment rather than a between-groups comparison (sorted eNK + IL-15 in culture -> acquisition of dNK-like phenotype and function). It sets the claim's strongest class to INF_INVITRO. fulltext_available for it must be recorded FALSE with reason: bronze-OA at the publisher per Unpaywall but journals.aai.org serves a JavaScript bot-challenge instead of the PDF (HTTP 200, 1,519 bytes), www.jimmunol.org returns HTTP 403, journals.aai.org article URLs 301-redirect to the academic.oup.com/jimmunol journal root, has_repository_copy=false, and the Wayback availability API returned HTTP 429; classification therefore derived from MeSH methods-indexing (Cells Cultured; Interleukin-15/pharmacology; Cell Differentiation/immunology; Up-Regulation/drug effects), NOT from abstract prose and NOT from read methods.

RECOMMENDED ROW STRUCTURE: keep Feyaerts 2024 (PMID 38571943 / PMC10987737) as the designated READABLE primary — it is the only source whose full methods can be verified, the auditor's reading of it is accurate, and its own limitations paragraph is the single best statement of why the human evidence base cannot support S3 ("we had no access to paired samples ... this poses inconceivable logistic and ethical barriers") — but demote it from "original" to "best-documented recent primary", and name Manaster 2008 as the claim's origin. Two further sources the row should carry that the auditor omitted entirely: Sojka DK et al., eLife 2014;3:e01659, PMID 24714492 / PMC3975579 (FULL TEXT READ — establishes that the uterus contains at least two independent NK lineages, which is the strongest form of the alternative explanation and needs no selection or expansion to work), and Tatematsu BK & Sojka DK, Mucosal Immunol 2025;18(2):390-401, PMID 39708955 (parabiosis: uterine trNK are cNK-derived and progesterone-gated — the most direct experimental opposition to S3 in any species, and it comes from the lab whose earlier paper the auditor used as their headline mouse citation).
